errors.name: EventNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an event is requested by an event ID that does not exist in the system.

errors.name: RegistrationNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a registration is requested by a registration ID that does not exist in the system.

errors.name: UserNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a user is requested by a user ID that does not exist in the system.

errors.name: EventCapacityExceededError
errors.description: Raised when a registration attempt is made for an event that has reached its capacity.
